beta.notes:
New in this version:
• When you are up to date on stable updates, a subtle Looking for beta? link now appears if a newer beta is available. It opens the beta-testing options so you can choose whether to join.

Fixes:
• Update checks now clarify that you are up to date for your selected update channel.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
